results.description: EMQX broker build (make emqx-enterprise-compile: mix deps.get + mix compile) — messaging/copy bound
notes: EMQX pins Erlang/OTP 28.5.0.7-2 (env.sh:3 (export OTP_VSN=28.5.0.7-2)), but the `erl` on PATH (/nix/store/khp1dd3fk8476mwg62cinwvk5a17r53s-erlang-29.1.1/lib/erlang/erts-17.1/bin/erl) is OTP 29 (erts-17.1): the umbrella build aborts in the :ezstd dependency's NIF makefile, which generates its env.mk via `erl -noshell -s init stop -eval …` — an idiom OTP 29 halts before evaluating (verified on this host: exit 0, no output at all), so `mix compile` fails with "No rule to make target '…/env.mk'"; no number is fabricated
